  Throughput = full-frame pixels / hot-loop time (cpu raymarch excl.
  JIT; rtx vkCmdTraceRays excl. pipeline/SBT/AS setup).
  sum = cpu + rtx: what running both paths concurrently delivers — the
  heterogeneous win, since scaling one device can't reach it. Adding
  more paths (gpu_glsl, gpu_ir, remote nodes) raises the sum further.
  Mpix/kWh = energy efficiency from RAPL (cpu) / NVML (gpu) counters.
  This is the separate axis that decides *which* devices to add to a
  datacenter; a dash means the counter wasn't available. Note rtx
  energy is trace-only and excludes the amortizable setup.
